title: Plane-wave cutoff (fixed during the auto loop)

ecutwfc.meaning: Plane-wave cutoff in Ry; in the LCAO route it mainly controls the real-space grid density, not a basis-set size.

constraints: User guidance 2026-10-23: 100 Ry is generally sufficient; ecutwfc is not a convergence axis in this round.
The template still ships 130 Ry; do not tune ecutwfc inside the loop.
